dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, hurry! It's almost time for us to join Hu Tao for dinner!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oooh, and we'll be meeting at... Xinyue Kiosk! It's the place with a reaaaally long waitlist!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: As expected of the parlor director — always so generous! C'mon, let's go!
